cover_headline: India Runs More Military Exercises With US Than Any Other Country

end.headline: India Runs More Military Exercises With US Than Any Other Country
end.line: A US fact sheet catalogues a 2026 exercise calendar spanning Yudh Abhyas, Tarang Shakti, Tiger Triumph and Malabar.

facts: India conducts more military exercises with the United States than with any other country, according to a US fact sheet titled "US-India Major Defense Partnership"
Tarang Shakti at Jodhpur was the first exercise on Indian soil to include US F-35 jets
India signed a $45 million contract with Boeing for maintenance and inspection of the Indian Navy's P-8I fleet

quote.speaker: Sergio Gor
quote.text: India conducts more military exercises with the United States than with any other nation on Earth, forging interoperability across land, sea, and air that cannot be improvised in a crisis
